name: Rettenberg
beschreibung: Rettenberg lies on the eastern edge of Kolsass in the district of Innsbruck-Land at about 900 meters above sea level. The house blends into the rural structure of the Tiroler surroundings and offers access to hiking trails and the nearby Inntalregion. Guests receive simple, functional rooms and regional meals. The property is suitable for stays that require peace and access to nature and excursion areas in the Tiroler Unterland.
